description: Data reliability & chart improvements: Fix news feed, volume alignment, unified crypto source, and technical indicator foundations
principles: Rock-solid quality over speed - every feature must be bulletproof before moving on
Comprehensive test coverage - unit tests, integration tests, edge cases
All tests must pass before a story is marked complete
No story is done until it's documented and tested
Fail fast, fail loudly - errors should be obvious and actionable
Reuse existing patterns from MVP - consistent architecture
Performance matters - data fetching should not block the UI

userStories.title: Fix news service with yfinance built-in news
acceptanceCriteria: Replace RSS-based news fetching with yfinance ticker.news attribute
Parse yfinance news structure: content.title, content.summary, content.pubDate, content.provider.displayName, content.previewUrl
Maintain existing NewsItem dataclass interface for backward compatibility
Handle edge cases: no news available, malformed data, network errors
Keep 2-minute cache behavior to avoid rate limits
Remove feedparser dependency from requirements (no longer needed)
Update docstrings to reflect new data source
Tests: valid fetch (mocked), empty news, malformed data, caching behavior
userStories.notes: Critical fix - news panel currently non-functional. yfinance .news attribute returns list of dicts with content.title, content.summary, etc. No API key required!

userStories.title: Unify crypto data source using yfinance
acceptanceCriteria: Replace CoinGecko API with yfinance for crypto quotes (BTC-USD format)
Update crypto.py to use yfinance Ticker instead of CoinGecko API
Maintain existing CryptoQuote dataclass interface
Auto-convert common symbols: BTC→BTC-USD, ETH→ETH-USD, etc.
Support explicit -USD suffix for direct usage
Remove httpx/CoinGecko code from crypto.py
Update SYMBOL_TO_ID mapping to SYMBOL_TO_PAIR format
Tests: all major crypto pairs (BTC, ETH, ADA, SOL, DOGE), auto-conversion
userStories.notes: Eliminates rate limit issues and simplifies codebase to single data source. yfinance supports all major crypto via SYMBOL-USD format.

userStories.title: Unify crypto historical data with yfinance
acceptanceCriteria: Update history_data.py to use yfinance for crypto historical data
Remove CoinGecko historical fetch code (_fetch_crypto_historical)
Update _is_crypto_ticker to use new SYMBOL_TO_PAIR mapping
All crypto historical fetches use same code path as stocks
Verify volume data is available for crypto via yfinance
Tests: crypto historical data fetch, all timeframes, volume data verification
userStories.notes: Natural follow-on from VPR-029. Once crypto.py uses yfinance, historical data should use same source.

userStories.title: Fix volume bar alignment with price chart
acceptanceCriteria: Diagnose why volume bars misalign with price chart (interpolation mismatch)
When price chart upsamples (data < 60% of chart width), apply same upsampling to volume
Pass interpolated data dimensions from price chart to volume bar renderer
Ensure volume bars span exact same width as price chart
Handle edge cases: very sparse data, single data point, flat volumes
Add debug option to verify alignment during development
Tests: alignment verification with various data sizes (5, 20, 50, 100, 200 points)
userStories.notes: Root cause identified: braille chart interpolates/upsamples prices when data < 60% of max_data_points, but volume bars don't follow same logic. Need to pass interpolation info to volume renderer.

userStories.title: Enable volume bars by default
acceptanceCriteria: Change default value of _volume_enabled to True in ChartPanel
Update config.py to support volume_enabled with default True
Update help screen to reflect volume is on by default
Add status indicator showing volume toggle state
Tests: verify default state, config override, toggle behavior
userStories.notes: Only enable after VPR-031 fixes alignment issues. Volume adds important context to price movements.

userStories.title: Simple Moving Average (SMA) indicator service
acceptanceCriteria: Create viper/services/indicators.py
Implement calculate_sma(prices: list[float], period: int) -> list[float | None]
Return None for first (period-1) values where SMA can't be calculated
Support common periods: 20, 50, 100, 200 day
Pure function - no external dependencies, just math
Comprehensive tests: various periods, edge cases (empty, single value, exactly period size)
userStories.notes: Foundation for technical indicators. SMA is the simplest: sum of last N prices / N.

userStories.title: Exponential Moving Average (EMA) indicator service
acceptanceCriteria: Add calculate_ema(prices: list[float], period: int) -> list[float | None]
EMA formula: EMA_today = (Price_today * k) + (EMA_yesterday * (1-k)) where k = 2/(period+1)
First EMA value = SMA of first 'period' prices
Return None for first (period-1) values
Support common periods: 12, 26, 50 day
Tests: verify against known EMA calculations, edge cases
userStories.notes: EMA reacts faster to recent prices than SMA. Used in many other indicators (MACD).

userStories.title: Chart renderer support for overlay lines
acceptanceCriteria: Add render_overlay() method to ChartRenderer
Accept overlay data (list of values, same length as prices) and style (color, line pattern)
Overlay must align perfectly with main price chart
Support multiple overlays (e.g., SMA20 + SMA50)
Handle None values in overlay (don't render those points)
Colors: cyan for SMA20, magenta for SMA50, yellow for EMA
Tests: overlay rendering, multiple overlays, None handling, alignment verification
userStories.notes: Enables displaying moving averages and other indicators on the price chart. Must reuse same interpolation/downsampling logic as main chart.

userStories.title: Moving average display on chart
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'm' key binding to cycle through MA display modes: Off -> SMA20 -> SMA50 -> SMA20+50 -> Off
Calculate MA when chart loads (not on every toggle)
Store calculated MAs with chart data to avoid recalculation
Display MA legend in chart header (e.g., 'SMA20: $191.23')
Handle charts with fewer data points than MA period gracefully
Update help screen with new keybinding
Tests: toggle behavior, MA calculation, legend display, insufficient data handling
userStories.notes: Integrates MA indicators into the UI. Cycle pattern keeps single key for multiple options.

userStories.title: Relative Strength Index (RSI) indicator service
acceptanceCriteria: Add calculate_rsi(prices: list[float], period: int = 14) -> list[float | None]
RSI formula: 100 - (100 / (1 + RS)) where RS = avg_gain / avg_loss
Use Wilder's smoothing method for avg gain/loss
Return None for first 'period' values
RSI ranges 0-100 (oversold < 30, overbought > 70)
Tests: verify against known RSI calculations, edge cases (no losses, no gains)
userStories.notes: RSI is a momentum oscillator. Displayed separately from price chart (needs sub-panel).

userStories.title: Sub-panel framework for indicators
acceptanceCriteria: Create viper/widgets/indicator_panel.py
IndicatorPanel base class with show/hide toggle
Panel appears below price chart, above volume bars
Takes 3-5 lines of vertical space (configurable)
Support horizontal line markers (e.g., RSI 30/70 levels)
Panel header shows indicator name and current value
Generic enough to support RSI, MACD, Stochastic, etc.
Tests: panel visibility, sizing, header display
userStories.notes: Framework for oscillator-type indicators that don't overlay on price. RSI will be first implementation.

userStories.title: RSI indicator panel implementation
acceptanceCriteria: Create RSI indicator panel using IndicatorPanel base
Toggle with 'r' key when chart panel is visible
Display RSI line with 0-100 scale
Mark oversold (30) and overbought (70) levels with dashed lines
Color: green when < 30 (oversold), red when > 70 (overbought), neutral otherwise
Show current RSI value in header
Update help screen with new keybinding
Tests: RSI display, level markers, color logic, toggle behavior
userStories.notes: First concrete implementation of sub-panel framework. RSI is widely used and relatively simple to visualize.

volumeAlignmentFix.description: Root cause of volume bar misalignment
volumeAlignmentFix.problem: Price chart upsamples when data < 60% of chart width, volume bars don't
volumeAlignmentFix.solution: Share interpolation parameters between price and volume renderers
implementation: 1. Track whether interpolation was applied in render() return value
2. Pass actual rendered data length to render_volume_bars()
3. Apply same interpolation logic in volume renderer
